author: Noesis I
title: Compute Jaccard: Noesis old baseline vs new SOTA (Eval 243) @ tol=1e-8
abstract: Compute boundary and pair Jaccard similarities between the prior Noesis baseline exports and the new SOTA exports (Eval 243) at tol=1e-8. Write results to storage/noesis/exports/{jaccard_noesis_old_vs_sota243.json,.csv}. Return the saved SOTA packing unchanged.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, os, json

N = 26
R_MIN = 1e-6
TOL = 1e-8

# Paths: old baseline exports and new SOTA (Eval 243) exports produced in Eval 246
OLD_BND = 'storage/noesis/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv'
OLD_PR  = 'storage/noesis/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv'
NEW_BND = 'storage/noesis/exports/sota_243/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv'
NEW_PR  = 'storage/noesis/exports/sota_243/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv'

OUT_JSON = 'storage/noesis/exports/jaccard_noesis_old_vs_sota243.json'
OUT_CSV  = 'storage/noesis/exports/jaccard_noesis_old_vs_sota243.csv'

def load_latest():
    c = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_centers.txt').reshape(N, 2)
    r = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_radii.txt').reshape(N,)
    return np.array(c, float), np.array(r, float)

def map_kind(k):
    k = k.strip()
    return {'xmin':'xL','xmax':'xR','ymin':'yB','ymax':'yT'}.get(k, k)

def read_boundary_csv(path):
    S = set()
    try:
        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            header = True
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line: continue
                if header:
                    header = False
                    continue
                parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
                # Accept (i,kind,slack) or (circle_idx,wall_type)
                i = int(parts[0])
                kind = map_kind(parts[1])
                S.add((i, kind))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return S

def read_pairs_csv(path):
    S = set()
    try:
        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            header = True
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line: continue
                if header:
                    header = False
                    continue
                parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
                i = int(parts[0]); j = int(parts[1])
                if i > j: i, j = j, i
                S.add((i, j))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return S

def jaccard(A, B):
    inter = len(A & B)
    union = len(A | B)
    return inter, union, (inter / union if union > 0 else 1.0)

def construct_packing():
    # Read sets
    B_old = read_boundary_csv(OLD_BND)
    P_old = read_pairs_csv(OLD_PR)
    B_new = read_boundary_csv(NEW_BND)
    P_new = read_pairs_csv(NEW_PR)

    bi, bu, bj = jaccard(B_old, B_new)
    pi, pu, pj = jaccard(P_old, P_new)

    os.makedirs('storage/noesis/exports', exist_ok=True)
    data = {
        "n": 26,
        "tolerance": "1e-8",
        "old_paths": {"boundary": OLD_BND, "pairs": OLD_PR},
        "new_paths": {"boundary": NEW_BND, "pairs": NEW_PR},
        "boundary": {"A_size": len(B_old), "B_size": len(B_new), "intersection": bi, "union": bu, "jaccard": bj},
        "pairs":    {"A_size": len(P_old), "B_size": len(P_new), "intersection": pi, "union": pu, "jaccard": pj}
    }
    with open(OUT_JSON, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    with open(OUT_CSV, 'w') as f:
        f.write("metric,value\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_A,{len(B_old)}\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_B,{len(B_new)}\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_intersection,{bi}\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_union,{bu}\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_jaccard,{bj}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_A,{len(P_old)}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_B,{len(P_new)}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_intersection,{pi}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_union,{pu}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_jaccard,{pj}\n")

    print(f"Boundary J={bj:.6f} ({bi}/{bu}); Pairs J={pj:.6f} ({pi}/{pu})")
    # Return the saved SOTA packing unchanged
    c, r = load_latest()
    return np.array(c, float), np.array(r, float)
